scripts.test: node --import tsx --test packages/*/test/*.test.ts apps/*/test/*.test.ts && npm run test -w @rai/web
scripts.test:e2e:web: npm run build && node --import tsx --test --test-concurrency=1 apps/web/e2e/web-flows.test.ts
scripts.test:e2e:responsive: npm run build && node --import tsx --test --test-concurrency=1 apps/web/e2e/web-flows.test.ts
scripts.test:e2e: npm run test:e2e:web && npm run test:e2e:responsive
scripts.test:all: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run ml:test && npm run test:e2e:web
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c green,cyan "npm run dev -w @rai/api" "npm run dev -w @rai/web"
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run start -w @rai/api
